name: Run Tests Before Commit
description: Intercepts git commit commands and runs the test suite first, blocking if tests fail
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run tests before allowing git commit
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then
  echo "Running tests before commit..."
  npm test 2>&1
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Tests failed. Fix tests before committing."
    exit 2
  fi
fi
exit 0
